intel_cost.title: Cost intelligence
intel_cost.subtitle: Where cost is rising, where factories differ, which suppliers raised prices, and which margins are at risk.
intel_cost.never_added: These are eight different measures. They are never added together: an estimate is not a loss, and a recommended saving is not an achieved one.
intel_cost.rising: Products whose unit cost is rising
intel_cost.rising_hint: Actual cost per unit of completed orders by month; rising across at least three months and more than 5%.
intel_cost.no_recs: No open cost recommendations. They appear after the daily run.
intel_cost.setup_hint: Setup and changeover minutes of completed operations over 90 days, from the changeover matrix where it has a rule, else the routing setup, priced at the centre rates. 15% or more of the orders' cost is excessive.
intel_cost.energy_hint: Electricity per finished unit by product over 90 days, against the median product; 1.5× or more is energy-intensive.
intel_cost.no_energy: No product has metered electricity in the period.
